copy_rule: Coverage at t is inherited as the transmissible immune repertoire available at t+1 unless doses stop or immunity wanes.
cut_rule: Zero new transmission of coverage: set vaccination_coverage to 0 from the cut time onward (rollback / no booster), leaving case-derived O/R/I untouched.
notes: S is coverage, not C. C remains intergenerational gain computed from S and V. Exploratory until a real OWID series is bound and N_min gates pass.
